title: Material disposition.
officialText:
Soil and rock samples shall be maintained in an accessible location by the permit holder or owner
and made available to the engineer responsible for the geotechnical investigation and to the department, until the foundation work
has been completed and accepted, or until 1 year after the investigation is complete, whichever is longer.
